title: Fans Flock to the Hollywood Sign. Neighbors Say, Get Off My Road.
summary: The residents of the Hollywood Hills have sued Los Angeles, saying the city has not done enough to address the dangerous conditions created by tourists vying for a glimpse of the iconic Hollywood sign.
